caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest or cabinet, centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. The furniture is rectangular, with a flat top and four short block legs. Its primary color is a rich brown with darker accents on the moulding and details, giving the appearance of domestic hardwood. The front face of the chest is adorned with decorative black spindle-like elements and geometric patterns, including a central diamond motif and rectangular border inlays. Two drawers are located at the bottom, each featuring a single round knob for handles, outlined with black framing. The central section above the drawers consists of three vertical panels, with the side panels each containing darker spindles and a spindle-shaped decoration. The structure is highlighted with gold-colored trim along the top and between the sections, accentuating the craftsmanship. On the lower right corner of the image, the name "ISABELLA RUTH DOERFLER" is written in small, capitalized letters. The overall tone of the drawing is realistic, with careful shading and detail emphasizing the texture and construction of the furniture piece.
title: Chest with Two Drawers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
